note: Godot-only content (not in the web game): written by hand, not exported. Texts use the Realmlings' words; Races.words gives each race its own.
DIG_FAILSAFE_NOTE: Each digger's chance rises with time spent digging: from the given cycle on (18 cycles = 3 minutes), the chance is at least the given value.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.blurb: Keeps the relics your Wayfinders find: 9 slots. Found items go straight into a Reliquary with room, wherever they are found. One per province; build more for more room.

dungeon.name: Dungeon
dungeon.blurb: Holds 3 prisoners taken in the Dungeon quests. One per province; build more for more cells. Multiplayer only.

callum.title: Rebuilding the Library: Lord Callum's Lawbook
callum.text: An ancient leader known only as Lord Callum famously wrote a book detailing the subtleties of Law and Order. Remnants of different copies of the book still exist in the world. If you find enough pieces we can recreate his work and use it to advance our government.

goals.label: Find copies of Lord Callum's Lawbook

callum.done_text: With the collected and complete Lawbook by Lord Callum our advisors have revised and reorganized our system to allow for more productivity with less oversight!

lionheart.title: Rebuilding the Library: General Lionheart's Records
lionheart.text: A fearsome general who once abandoned his besieged home capital and led his remaining people into the sanctuary of remote mountains left a detailed record of every decision that led to his people's eventual extinction. Learning from his faults will help us avoid making his mistakes.

goals.label: Find copies of General Lionheart's Records

lionheart.done_text: General Lionheart was not a fool. He fought well against a vastly superior opponent. Knowing his tactics will aid us in organizing our own people. Rest easy, General.

brune.title: Rebuilding the Library: Minister Brune's Guide to Effective Government
brune.text: Brune was not only a legendary warrior but a wise advisor to his king. After years of war and many campaigns to the frozen north he returned to his homeland and wrote about not the fighting, but what to do when the fighting ends. His advice is invaluable. We must acquire his lost writings.

goals.label: Find copies of Minister Brune's Guides

brune.done_text: Brune would have been a great king, but he was a better advisor. With his preserved words we will take his advice and build our nation stronger than ever.

darksoc.title: A Forgotten War: Emblems of the Dark Society
darksoc.text: One of the first known military cults that held control over these lands was the Dark Society. We know little about them, only that their warriors were mythical. Acquiring these Emblems will give our military insights a boost.

goals.label: Find Emblems of the Dark Society

darksoc.done_text: The Dark Society was the pinnacle of its day, but its day is over. Now we shall rule.

signet.title: A Forgotten War: Signets of the Lost Soldiers
signet.text: The signets of these soldiers indicate that this band of unnamed brethren once stood united, but for some unknown reason scattered to the wind. These soldiers are found all throughout the land with their signets identifying them. Let us collect these signets and advance our knowledge of military brotherhood.

goals.label: Find Signets of the Lost Soldiers

signet.done_text: The lost and forgotten once held the tightest bonds. Why they abandoned each other but kept their keepsake signets still remains a mystery.

coin.title: A Forgotten War: Coins of the Fallen Masters
coin.text: These mysterious Masters fell only three generations ago. We know they were not only master warriors but tax collectors for their King as well. Maybe the warrior class should be more inclusive? Collect more Coins of the Fallen Masters.

goals.label: Find Coins of the Fallen Masters

coin.done_text: Their high honor and status did not make them impervious to the ravages of time and entropy. We can only take their lessons and hold out hope that time isn't so cruel with our legacy.

quarterroyal.title: A Mage's Request: More Quarterroyal!
quarterroyal.text: Our Mages demand more Quarterroyal for study! This will help them improve their research.

peacock.title: A Mage's Request: More Peacock's Eye!
peacock.text: Our Mages demand more Peacock's Eye for study! This will help them improve their research.

lizardroot.title: A Mage's Request: More White Lizardroot!
lizardroot.text: Our Mages demand more White Lizardroot for study! This will help them improve their research.

freakarmor.title: Reclaiming Battlegear: The Freak Man's Skeleton
freakarmor.text: The Legend of the Freak Man is not a tale worth repeating. He was less a warrior and more a butcher. Wearing only the enchanted bones from his fallen foes he would ambush his enemies and somehow steal their power. His atrocities are told only in the quietest of whispers. If we recover his bones, maybe we too could have that power.
freakarmor.done_text: Our Forgemasters have collaborated with our Mages and have made the Freak Man's Armor available for mass production. Our armies will fear none.

runearmor.title: Reclaiming Battlegear: An Ancient Armor
runearmor.text: This Runed Metal is not just another relic, but it is a piece of the Ancient Siegebreaker Armor! This is a rare find! If we complete the set we could outfit our own warriors with this magic armor. No tower could stand against the might of such battlegear.
runearmor.done_text: Our Forgemasters have collaborated with our Mages and have made the Siegebreaker Runeplate available for mass production. Our armies will conquer all.

beastleather.title: Reclaiming Battlegear: Hides of Mythical Beasts
beastleather.text: Seven generations ago the Huntress Yenny would exclusively kill primal creatures that did not belong in our realm. It seems they have once again taken up residence here. If you reclaim enough of these creatures' hides, our Mages can easily recreate her legendary Leather Armor.
beastleather.done_text: Our Mages have recreated the ancient huntress' leather and it is now available for mass production. Our armies will march swiftly to our enemies' weak spots.

flamebook.title: The Spell Book of Flame
flamebook.text: Our Mages tell us of a spell that could turn the tide against our enemies! Our Mages will gain the ability to summon walls of fire! All they ask of us is to bring them the remaining Pages of Flame and a Binding of Flame.
flamebook.done_text: Success! Our Mages are now ready for battle!

timebook.title: The Spell Book of Time
timebook.text: Our Mages tell us of a spell that could advance our civilization's productivity! Our Mages will gain the ability to alter time itself in a limited capacity! All they ask of us is to bring them the remaining Pages of Time and a Binding of Time.
timebook.done_text: Success! Our Mages are now ready to enhance our nation!

triune.title: Lost Armaments: The Triune Staff
triune.text: Our Mages tell us of a Legendary Magical Staff that gifts our nation with deep wells of magic! Our Mages will have deeper wells of magic than they could ever otherwise reach! Return the pieces of the staff and our Mages can duplicate it with enough Fallen Stars.
triune.done_text: Magnificent! Our Mages are now more powerful than ever!

cutlass.title: Lost Armaments: Jagkara's Cutlass
cutlass.text: Ahh! The lost treasure of Jagkara! If we find the rest of the pieces of the map we can find its final resting place.

part2.text: The Lost Cutlass of Jagkara! Now we just need to get it to our Forgemasters for production!

cutlass.done_text: Jagkara was known as arrogant and bullheaded, but he was also an unmatched genius. We will use his genius to strengthen our armies!

freakaxe.title: Lost Armaments: The Freak Man's Axe
freakaxe.text: Ahh! The lost treasure of the Freak Man! If we find the rest of the pieces of the map we can find its final resting place.

part2.text: The Freak Man! X marks the spot! Now we just need to get the axe to our Forgemasters for production!

freakaxe.done_text: The Freak Man was clearly tormented by some sort of demons that drove him to be such an intimidating foe. It is whispered that his armies were the ones that destroyed General Lionheart's home. We will use his demons to strengthen our armies!
freakaxe.reward_text: Weapon: The Freak Man's Axe unlocked

greedmaul.title: Lost Armaments: The Maul of Greed
greedmaul.text: Ahh! The lost treasure of the Maul of Greed! If we find the rest of the pieces of the map we can find its final resting place.

part2.text: We have the Maul of Greed! We must get the maul to our Forgemasters for production.

greedmaul.done_text: Greed in this context was a raider, his desire for loot surpassed all his comrades and his name was forgotten in place of his overwhelming desires. This Maul was his most prized possession. Hopefully we won't succumb to its curse.
greedmaul.reward_text: Weapon: The Maul of Greed unlocked

sham.title: Lost Armaments: The Shield of Sham
sham.text: Ahh! The lost treasure of the Shield of Sham! If we find the rest of the pieces of the map we can find its final resting place.

part2.text: We have the Shield of Sham! We must get the shield to our Forgemasters for production.

sham.done_text: The Shield of Sham to the outsider looks like some random sticks wrapped around a wooden plank, but it's the binding magic within that makes it such a useful armament!
sham.reward_text: Shield: The Shield of Sham unlocked

jailbreak.title: Jailbreak!
jailbreak.text: Our nation's hardened criminals have escaped from our dungeon. We must have justice! They cannot be allowed to escape! Track them down!
jailbreak.done_text: Our nation is one that affirms justice. We hold the worst of the worst in our dungeons.
jailbreak.reward_text: Execute them: +300 Government and +300 Military research. Pardon them: 8 Convicts join your army.
